name: knap-template
description: Local, source-first Markdown publishing with Knap templates and Pandoc

scripts.check: knap validate templates/frontmatter.kmd && knap validate templates/reference-index.kmd
scripts.html: npm run render && pandoc build/report.md --citeproc --csl styles/hull-harvard.csl --standalone --mathml -o build/report.html
